Research Interests

My research focuses on GeoAI and spatial data science for traffic safety and urban mobility systems. I study multi-source spatiotemporal data fusion, spatial heterogeneity and cross-scale modeling of road-safety risk, driving and travel behavior, dynamic risk prediction, proactive safety assessment, and data-driven traffic simulation.
